arStrings.szText: Nightmare Dungeon keys with the {c_highlight}Rupture{/c} affix are now available.
Defeat {c_highlight}Realmbreakers{/c} from {c_highlight}Surging Ruptures{/c} for a chance to earn these dungeon keys!
Close {c_highlight}Tears{/c} within Nightmare Dungeon {c_highlight}Ruptures{/c} to open a portal to the {c_highlight}Deathtoll Chamber{/c}.
